annotations.title: Size-aware dry run of a swap into a stock token

description: Before a swap into a stock token, ask what a given dollar amount would get right now, for that exact size. First the verdict, as verify_stock_tokens gives it: a look-alike or a token not on the issuer's list is refused and gets no quote at all (use_instead names the listed contract). For a listed token: a live quote (on Base Aerodrome's own pools read from its contracts, with KyberSwap across venues as a second line; on Robinhood Chain KyberSwap), the tokens out, the effective price, the minimum received at your slippage, gas, the effective premium over the issuer's reference against a limit (yours, or 3% by default, measured both ways), the sell-back of those tokens, and the market session and the reference's age. With a public wallet address it also runs that swap as a dry run by eth_call for that wallet at one block, overriding only the stable balance, approval and gas it lacks, and says whether it would revert and why. Nothing is signed or sent, and no transaction is returned. A quote lives seconds: it says when it was taken and is treated as current for 15 s. The wallet goes to the aggregator and the node for this one answer and is kept nowhere. Never pass a private key. Costs 10 units of the rate limit, 15 with a wallet. Facts, not advice.

chain.description: which chain and issuer list: base (Coinbase's list, USDC) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list, USDG)

max_premium.description: the premium limit to compare with, as a fraction (0.03 is 3%), 0 to 0.5; default 0.03

slippage_bps.description: the slippage for the minimum received, in basis points, 1 to 500; default 50

token.description: the token contract address, or a ticker (TSLA or TSLAc) that must match exactly one issuer-listed token on that chain

usd.description: the amount to spend in the chain's dollar stable (USDC on Base, USDG on Robinhood Chain), 1 to 1000000, at most 2 decimals

wallet.description: optional: your PUBLIC wallet address, for the dry run; never a private key
